title: Admin microflow governance playbook and productization plan
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: Over the last 12 months we instrumented dozens of ad-hoc admin utilities and short-run runbooks inside the operator tooling. While individual scripts and playbooks helped oncall throughput, we now have sprawl: duplicated snippets, inconsistent RBAC, unpredictable cost from long-running helper flows, and no single source of truth for safe execution patterns. This initiative aims to productize 'runbooks-as-microflows' and a governance playbook so that support automation scales without increasing operational risk.

Goals: 1) Define a minimal governance surface for admin microflows (auth, consent, telemetry, auditing, idempotency). 2) Provide a product spec and rollout for the microflow catalog, including lifecycle (review, deprecation, versioning). 3) Deliver a lightweight self-serve admin utility kit (CLI + console integration) and policy hooks for Dedicated/Private customers. 4) Reduce mean time to remediate for top-10 incident classes by 25% while limiting tool-enabled blast radius.

Scope: Product design, policy templates, rollout plan, acceptance criteria, and OKRs. Engineering implementation is a dependency (see ENG-271444, ENG-771212). Out of scope for this ticket: full reimplementation of the runtime; we'll rely on existing runbook execution fabric and add governance layers and UX surface.

Success metrics: - Catalog adoption: 60% of ops incidents use microflow helpers within 3 months of launch. - Safety: zero unauthorized-execution incidents; audit trails present for 100% of microflow runs. - Cost: per-incident execution token/time reduced by 20% vs baseline.

Minimum viable deliverables: 1) Governance doc (auth model, approval gates, RBAC mapping, allowed scopes). 2) Microflow spec template (inputs, outputs, idempotency contract, audit fields). 3) Console UX wireframes for the microflow catalog and run review. 4) Developer guidelines and PR checklist for admitting microflows into the catalog. 5) Rollout checklist and customer communication plan.
acceptance_criteria: Governance doc reviewed and signed off by Security and Legal
Microflow spec template published in Confluence with examples
Console wireframes validated with two SRE teams and UX-approved
Onboarding checklist exists and a pilot group of 3 teams completes onboarding
Telemetry contract agreed: required audit fields and retention documented
